Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:47002
Court No. - 11
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8573 of 2023

Applicant :- Sunita Devi Alias Sunita Tiwari
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ankit Pande,Pooja Devi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the sister of the informant was married to the son of the applicant on 03.05.2022 and she died on account of harassment by the entire matrimonial family.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant argues that the applicant is the mother-in-law and in support of the allegations contained in the FIR, no specific averments were made against the applicant.
She draws my attention to the post-mortem report, which records the reason of death as ante-mortem Sunita Devi Alias Sunita Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin Secy. Home Lko.

sentences.text:
on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138850411/
1 hanging.
No injury other than the ligature mark is present on the body in question.
Although, there is one old abrasion on the right forearm.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that the applicant is a lady and no specific allegation is leveled against the applicant in support of the offence in question and the cause of death also does not reveal any physical harassment prior to the death coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 22.04.2023 and has no criminal antecedent, as such, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Sunita Devi alias Sunita Tiwari be released on bail in FIR No.0136 of 2023,
under Section 498A, 304B IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kauriya, District Gonda on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 19.7.2023 nishant  Sunita Devi Alias Sunita Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin Secy. Home Lko.
